# snail

Reusable agent skills and an optional stage-gated workflow.

## Entry points

- README.md — overview and quick start
- AGENTS.md — agent index and workflow notes
- package.json — package manager (nub), scripts, and dependencies

## Skills

- skills/sk-ai-toolbelt/SKILL.md
- skills/sk-alternatives/SKILL.md
- skills/sk-explore/SKILL.md
- skills/sk-flow/SKILL.md
- skills/sk-implement/SKILL.md
- skills/sk-planning/SKILL.md
- skills/sk-planning/templates/masterplan.md
- skills/sk-planning/templates/plan.md
- skills/sk-pr/SKILL.md
- skills/sk-project-docs/SKILL.md
- skills/sk-review-alternatives/SKILL.md
- skills/sk-review-plan/SKILL.md
- skills/sk-review/SKILL.md
- skills/sk-verify/SKILL.md

## Rules

- rules/no-comments.md
- rules/snail.md

## Scripts

- skills/sk-flow/scripts/flow-state.sh — the runbook gate (init/check/advance/note/set)
- skills/sk-implement/scripts/run-with-receipt.sh + check-receipt.sh — check receipts
- skills/sk-planning/scripts/lint-plan.sh — plan structure lint
- scripts/install.sh — install the Cursor plugin
- scripts/install-claude-rules.sh — install rules into ~/.claude
- scripts/sync-devin-plugin.sh — sync skills/rules into plugins/snail
